label: General scam red flags
source_name: FTC: How to Avoid a Scam
facts: No real business or government agency will ever tell you to buy a gift card to pay them.
Only scammers will tell you to buy a gift card and give them the numbers off the back of the card.
Government agencies will not contact you to demand immediate payment, and they never demand payment by gift card.
Honest organizations will not call, email, or text to ask for your personal information, like your Social Security, bank account, or credit card numbers.
Honest businesses will give you time to make a decision. Anyone who pressures you to pay or give them your personal information is a scammer.
Scammers insist that you can only pay with cryptocurrency, a wire transfer service, a payment app, or a gift card. Never pay someone who insists on paying that way.
Scammers pressure you to act immediately, and might threaten to arrest you, sue you, take away your driver's or business license, or deport you.
